text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: As I happened to walk past the classroom...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Charge forth!
Fast-Running Squadron, Umamusume 5!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
The red of Hokkaido's salmon roe!
"Red Special"!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (BOOOM!)

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
W-What happened all of a sudden, Spe-chan?
What was that just now...?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
A hero show! A hero show!
See, we gotta come up with an act for the Fan Appreciation Festival, right?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: "So when I asked Biko-san, who loves heroes, she said, 'This'll definitely be a hit!'"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Rather than fretting over every little detail at the last minute,
why don't we just settle on this and get to practicing?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
The Fan Appreciation Festival performances...
Come to think of it, there was something like that, wasn't there?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Better safe than sorry.
All right~. In that case, I'll keep you company.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seemed El Condor Pasa and her classmates
had started practicing for a hero show.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Well then, as for me... let's see~.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
The intellectual blue returning from America.
'Bluegrass'

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Crash!)

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Would it be something like this?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: I guess I'm next~.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
A drifting white guided by whim.
"White Sky"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Floaty-floaty~)

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
S-She stole almost all the spotlight!
If that's how it is~!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Debuting midway through the series! Descending from the heavens, the premier gold, "Gold King"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*GLEAM*!!)

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Ooh, you really piled it high, huh～

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, you're joining in too, El-chan, right?
What're you gonna do? What're you gonna do?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I'm... nooot doing it.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Wait... Whyyyy!?
choice_data_list: Are you feeling unwell or something?
Are you feeling unwell or something?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
No, my condition is... normal, yeees!
It's just that El has decided to walk a different path alone.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I cannot play with everyone anymore, no.
I am the Aztec hero who fights alone, yes.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: —Ciao.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
El Condor Pasa walks away.
Having stepped off the Triple Crown path, she seems to be
drawing a line in her personal life as well.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: El-chan left...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, hero show practice went on without El Condor Pasa...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
What do we do?!
We're gonna be wiped out at this rate!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ghk, curse you, evil organization "Umaaa"! Not being
blinded by gold—how utterly despicable!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Aren't you playing far dirtier yourself?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"No way, even my stratagem didn't work...?
What should I do...?"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Bwahaha!
Looks like you're in a pinch, everyone, yes!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Th-This voice is...?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Toh!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Gallant! Tempestuous! A close shave!
The mysterious masked warrior "Aztec Condor"
has a-rri-ved, YEEES!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
El!?
I thought you weren't going to do it!?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: "Tsk, tsk, tsk~ Of course it's a surprise meant to shock and delight everyone!"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Even if our paths diverge,
we are still friends, yes!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: And besides, El was told by her wrestler papa!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"They said, 'A true entertainer doesn't just run strong—
they bring joy to the fans!'"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Everyone was thrilled by El Condor Pasa's surprise entrance.
It certainly wouldn't have been this exciting
had she been part of it from the very beginning.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A born showman. Her knack for entertaining people
seems likely to have a positive impact on her future
as an Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho!
Looks like everyone's gathered, Umamusume 5.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Still, Planet Tracen will be mine to take.
Claimed by none other than Pearl Nice Nature, one of the Big Three♪

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Aaaaagh, Pearl-senpai!
When did you get back from France!?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Welcome baaaack! Tell me all about your heroic deeds,
glorious tales, and souvenirs, pleeease!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'm home, El. Of course, I'd love to.
Though, before that...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Once I take this planet, that is!
Now, bring it on!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... And here I was thinking
we'd finally get to take a break~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With Seeking the Pearl, whom El Condor Pasa respects,
joining in, the show rehearsal became even more lively.
